description: This file defines the MessageCenter class, which manages message sending, receiving, forwarding, and rejection within the Orleans runtime messaging system. It handles proxy delivery, message blocking, connection management, and activation processing.

classes.name: MessageCenter
classes.description: Manages message flow within the Orleans runtime, including sending, receiving, forwarding, and rejection of messages, as well as connection and activation management.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops message processing and blocks application messages.

methods.name: SetHostedClient
methods.description: Sets the hosted client for message dispatching.

methods.name: TryDeliverToProxy
methods.description: Attempts to deliver a message directly to a proxy if applicable.

methods.name: StopAcceptingClientMessages
methods.description: Stops accepting new client messages and stops the gateway if present.

methods.name: SniffIncomingMessage
methods.description: Property to set or get a handler for incoming message sniffing.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message, handling local delivery, proxy delivery, or forwarding as needed.

methods.name: DispatchLocalMessage
methods.description: Dispatches a message directly to local activation.

methods.name: RejectMessage
methods.description: Rejects a message with specified rejection type and reason.

methods.name: ProcessRequestsToInvalidActivation
methods.description: Processes a list of messages targeting invalid activations, either rejecting or forwarding them.

methods.name: ProcessRequestToInvalidActivation
methods.description: Processes a single message targeting an invalid activation, invalidating cache and forwarding or rejecting.

methods.name: TryForwardRequest
methods.description: Attempts to forward a message to another silo, with error handling.

methods.name: RerouteMessage
methods.description: Resends a message through the forwarding mechanism.

methods.name: TryForwardMessage
methods.description: Checks if a message can be forwarded based on max forward count and performs forwarding.

methods.name: ResendMessageImpl
methods.description: Resends a message, possibly targeting a system target or forwarding address.

methods.name: AddressAndSendMessage
methods.description: Addresses a message asynchronously and sends it.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Creates and sends a response message for a request.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, including proxy delivery, response processing, and activation routing.

methods.name: ProcessMessageToNonExistentActivation
methods.description: Handles messages for non-existent activations, sending rejections or attempting creation.

methods.name: SendRejection
methods.description: Sends a rejection message, avoiding rejection of already rejected messages.
